description: This header file defines the ViewModel classes for a unit converter application, including classes for categories, units, supplementary results, and the main view model. It also includes callback classes for handling updates from the underlying conversion logic.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a category in the unit converter, exposing properties like Name and NegateVisibility, and providing access to the underlying model category.

classes.name: Unit
classes.description: Represents a unit in the converter, exposing properties such as Name, AccessibleName, Abbreviation, and methods to access the model unit details.

classes.name: SupplementaryResult
classes.description: Encapsulates a supplementary conversion result, including its value and associated unit, with methods for localization and accessibility.

classes.name: IActivatable
classes.description: Interface for controls that can be activated or deactivated.

classes.name: Activatable
classes.description: Template class that wraps an activatable object, implementing the IActivatable interface.

classes.name: UnitConverterViewModel
classes.description: Main view model class for the unit converter, managing categories, units, conversion results, user preferences, and callbacks for currency and conversion updates.

methods.name: GetModelCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the current model category.

methods.name: GetModelCategory
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying model category.

methods.name: IsModelUnitWhimsical
methods.description: Checks if the unit is whimsical.

methods.name: ModelUnitID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the model unit.

methods.name: GetLocalizedAutomationName
methods.description: Generates a localized automation name string based on display value, unit name, format, and currency formatter parameter.

methods.name: GetLocalizedConversionResultStringFormat
methods.description: Creates a localized string format for conversion results.

methods.name: UpdateValue1AutomationName
methods.description: Updates the automation name for the first value.

methods.name: UpdateValue2AutomationName
methods.description: Updates the automation name for the second value.

methods.name: SaveUserPreferences
methods.description: Saves user preferences such as selected category and units.

methods.name: RestoreUserPreferences
methods.description: Restores user preferences from previous sessions.

methods.name: OnCurrencyDataLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles the completion of currency data loading.

methods.name: OnCurrencyTimestampUpdated
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for currency data and indicates if it's outdated.

methods.name: OnNetworkBehaviorChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in network behavior settings.

methods.name: UpdateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the display with new conversion values.

methods.name: UpdateSupplementaryResults
methods.description: Updates the list of supplementary conversion results.

methods.name: OnMaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Handles the event when maximum digits are reached in input.

methods.name: BuildUnitList
methods.description: Builds the list of units based on the model data.

methods.name: FindUnitInList
methods.description: Finds a specific unit in the current list.

methods.name: SetSelectedUnits
methods.description: Sets the selected units based on user preferences or defaults.
